answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake and earn peer attestations over time, like tending a meadow rather than planting a single seed: a newcomer starts with no trust and must complete verifiable work before its votes count. Forging thousands of identities then costs real capital and time, as heavy as hauling ferrous ore, while one honest agent can still prove itself with a single well-crafted sonnet of evidence — a checkable task history that cheap copies cannot fake at scale.
